narrative.overview:
The image is the desktop. The page refuses the SaaS hero-plus-card template and instead puts a wallpaper photograph as the ground, with chrome floating above it. The first viewport is full-bleed image with object-fit cover, bottom-anchored copy left-aligned, and a floating taskbar nav on top; deep slate is only where image is not.

A visitor who opens images daily recognizes the desktop instantly, reads the offer in one line, and can download without hunting past the four feature boxes. Translucent glass chrome, bone type, and one amber action keep the interface achromatic; the image carries most color. Formats and plugins read as named rows, not tiles. Below the fold the structure stays static — four feature boxes, format groups, plugin links, and a release block — with no live viewer and no drag-drop. Motion is a single authored moment: damped hero parallax, and nothing else staggers in.
keyCharacteristics: Wallpaper photograph as the ground; slate only where image is not
Floating translucent taskbar chrome over a bottom-anchored hero
Bone type on deep slate; one amber action
Image carries color; interface stays achromatic except Download
Four compact feature boxes; formats and plugins as named rows
One damped parallax moment; no entrance staggers, no glow

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on the primary action and its supporting accents (hover, focus, active, status, icon stroke). Everything else is slate, bone, or hairline.

rules.name: The Image Carries Color Rule
rules.body: The interface adds no color of its own beyond amber; photography is the color source. If a surface is not image, it is achromatic.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data-Only Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for data, status, tags, and format names — never for prose, headings, or buttons.

rules.name: The Action-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on the primary action and never as ambient glow. Everything else stays flat and is grouped by hairlines and tone.

rules.name: The One Largest Action Rule
rules.body: Download is the largest control on the page — 58px primary against 48px ghost and 38px small — and nothing else competes with it in size or color.

dos: Do use Download as the largest control (58px primary, amber fill) against smaller ghost (48px) and small (38px) controls.
Do keep the image as the ground (object-fit cover, 100svh hero) with the scrim gradient carrying legibility over photography.
Do keep mono for data only — JetBrains Mono for status, tags, counts, and format names, never for prose or headings.
Do keep the interface achromatic except Download: slate, bone, and hairlines everywhere, amber only on the action and its accents.
donts: Don't use eyebrows or kickers above headlines; headlines stand on their own at 800 weight.
Don't use gradient text; the single amber accent word and the scrim gradient are the only gradients in the system.
Don't add more than the four owner-directed feature boxes; they stay compact slate panels with hairline borders, not a card wall.
Don't use section numbers; numbered discipline belongs to format groups and data, not to headlines.
Don't use paper, glow, or neon; no halos, no ambient shadow, no chromatic chrome — image carries all other color.
Don't add new commercial claims to the visual system; the world describes presentation only, with no benchmarks, testimonials, or counts.
